name: .410 254gr Stone Hammer®

slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist rate is 1-19″ or faster

note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This Stone Hammer® was designed in collaboration with the 41 Great Lakes straight wall cartridge project. This pure copper bullet is designed with a secant ogive to boost ballistic coefficient in order to extend the capable range of the straight wall cartridge and still meet state regulations for straight wall cartridge hunting."
